hook_text: A whole country with no sea, completely surrounded by South Africa. Which one?
clip_script: Ladybrand, Free State. Across the river: Maseru, capital of Lesotho, a landlocked country completely surrounded by South Africa. Coastal countries touch the sea. Landlocked countries do not, and Africa has sixteen of them. Some countries lie north of the equator, some south, and some, like Kenya and Uganda, right on it. Out in the Indian Ocean, Madagascar, home of the lemurs. And Zanzibar, the spice islands of Tanzania.
visual_style: Whiteboard map of Africa with landlocked countries shading in, the equator drawn across, and two islands popping up in the Indian Ocean.
mood: Playful and puzzling, like sorting cards into groups.
pacing: Three quick sorting rounds: sea, equator, islands.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and sort five African countries into coastal and landlocked.
